verdict.rationale: The developer docs confirm a built-in assistant: 'Ask AI' chats whose messages include tool calls, plus scheduled prompts that create chats automatically. That suggests users can hand it questions and recurring prompts, but the evidence only appears indirectly through API endpoint descriptions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of what tasks the assistant can actually carry out, any evidence it takes actions beyond querying lifelogs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation working in practice.
